name: Vampir
subtitle: Night’s Hunger
description: Drain the lifeforce of your enemies and corrupt their souls stealing their buffs.
lore: Far and away the most infamous of Vyraj’s creatures, the vampir is a dreadful hunter of the night. Risen from the grave, they feast upon the blood of the living, using their supernatural abilities to hunt, to destroy, to dominate. The strongest of them, Dracula, controls a great many vampir, but many more serve other masters, gods, or their own agendas.
